Context: 5. Transport Allowance

## 5. Transport Allowance  
[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part- II]  
All employees are entitled to Transport Allowance as below:-  
| | Rate of Transport Allowance | Rate of Transport Allowance |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Pay Level | Higher TPTA Cities* (?p,m.) | Other Places (~ p.m.) |
| 9 and above | 7,200 + DA | 3,600 + DA |
| 3 to 8 | 3,600 + OA | 1,800 + DA |
| 1 and 2 | 1,350 + DA | 900 + DA |  
Order 2, Appendix 5.
